infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Belay connects to your PC on your local network or Tailscale to control it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Belay uses the camera to scan the pairing code shown on your computer, and to take a photo to send to Claude.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Belay listens while you hold the talk button so your words can be dictated into the prompt. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Belay turns your speech into text on this iPhone while you hold the talk button. Audio never leaves the device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Belay lets you pick photos or screenshots to send to Claude on your computer.
